items.q: What does the free consultation with Pedlex involve?
items.a: The free consultation is a first conversation with our team about your warehouse, your needs and your storage challenges. It helps us understand your situation and explore possible ways to optimize your space and your operations.

items.q: Can Pedlex optimize an existing racking system?
items.a: Yes. Pedlex can review your current layout to find ways to make better use of your space and adapt it to your operations.

items.q: Can a new racking system increase my storage capacity?
items.a: Yes. A better-suited layout can help you use more of your available floor space and height while making your inventory easier to reach. Some clients have recovered 30 to 50% more space.

items.q: I'm not sure which type of racking suits my warehouse. Can you help?
items.a: Yes. Our team looks at your space, your products and the way you work to steer you toward a solution that fits.
